replacements.from: HVAC companies in four U.S. markets report 40 to 50% of warm-air calls resolving on simple checks.
replacements.to: HVAC company websites in four U.S. markets describe about half of warm-air calls as simple or checkable causes. These are company assertions, not measured national odds.

replacements.from: Sources 1 to 4 are individual HVAC companies describing their own service calls in their own markets, not national research.
replacements.to: Sources 1 to 4 are HVAC company website assertions from four U.S. markets, including one that repeats unattributed industry data; they are not measured national odds.
Check the price for your filter size and type.

replacements.from: The air filter price is a retail part cost, not a repair, and carries no citation because no source we would stand behind publishes a national figure for it.
replacements.to: Filter prices depend on size and type; no generic national filter price is displayed.
Leave a tripped breaker off; call for service.

replacements.from: A frozen coil caused by a dirty filter resolves at service call money; one caused by a damaged coil runs to the top of the range.
replacements.to: The guide separates common central-AC repairs at $150–$650 from evaporator replacement at $700–$2,500+; these are cause-dependent examples.

replacements.from: Supports the $150 to $2,500 spread for a frozen evaporator coil, which depends entirely on the underlying cause.
replacements.to: Supports the stated central-AC repair and evaporator-replacement categories, not one closed frozen-coil price range.
Cause-dependent: common central-AC repairs $150–$650; evaporator replacement $700–$2,500+.

replacements.from: Carrier gives $100 to $400 covering part and professional installation; we publish the narrower $150 to $400 because Carrier’s own figure of $75 to $150 per hour for technician time makes the $100 floor an edge case.
replacements.to: Carrier publishes $100 to $400 for the part and professional installation; the actual price varies with the unit and local rates.
